x-poll-posts.name: X Poll Posts
x-poll-posts.description: Poll own posts via X API v2 (Owned Read) and enqueue to runner queue for drain.
x-poll-posts.prerequisite: integrations.x.accounts in jeeves-scripts.json lists the handles, each with its OAuth JSON file x-<handle>-oauth2.json in the X OAuth dir. With no args the job covers every configured handle (see guides/x.md)
